x: Has been in hospital with a touch of malaria, but his sister Lilian says he is now convalescent. Will Rispin is another out in the M.E. Sends greetings to all members and hopes they are keeping the claret and gold well to the front.

Will Rispin, M.E.F., wishes to be remembered to all his old associates at Belgrave Hall and is eagerly looking forward to the next "Mag." Dick Towndrow, now stationed in one of England's front lines, has an O.C. who actually encourages sport.

Will Rispin, home on leave from Italy and lookng very bronzed and fit, has been to the Hall and enjoyed an outing on the Common. Tommy Scrimshaw has left Scotland and now does his R.A.F. duties in London and is now billeted at home.
